verses.original: Παῦλος δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς Φιλήμονι τῷ ἀγαπητῷ καὶ συνεργῷ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Paulos desmios Christou Iēsou kai Timotheos ho adelphos Philēmoni tō agapētō kai synergō hēmōn
verses.literal: Paul a prisoner of Christ Jesus and Timothy our brother To Philemon our beloved fellow worker

verses.original: καὶ Ἀπφίᾳ τῇ ἀδελφῇ καὶ Ἀρχίππῳ τῷ συστρατιώτῃ ἡμῶν καὶ τῇ κατ’ οἶκόν σου ἐκκλησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: kai Apphia tē adelphē kai Archippō tō systratiōtē hēmōn kai tē kat’ oikon sou ekklēsia
verses.literal: to Apphia our sister to Archippus our fellow soldier and to the church that meets at your house

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου πάντοτε μνείαν σου ποιούμενος ἐπὶ τῶν προσευχῶν μου
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō tō Theō mou pantote mneian sou poioumenos epi tōn proseuchōn mou
verses.literal: I always thank . . . my God remembering . . . you in my prayers

verses.original: ἀκούων σου τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις πρὸς τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους
verses.transliteration: akouōn sou tēn agapēn kai tēn pistin hēn echeis pros ton Kyrion Iēsoun kai eis pantas tous hagious
verses.literal: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints

verses.original: ὅπως ἡ κοινωνία τῆς πίστεώς σου ἐνεργὴς γένηται ἐν ἐπιγνώσει παντὸς ἀγαθοῦ τοῦ ἐν ἡμῖν εἰς Χριστόν
verses.transliteration: hopōs hē koinōnia tēs pisteōs sou energēs genētai en epignōsei pantos agathou tou en hēmin eis Christon
verses.literal: I pray that your partnership in the faith may become effective as you fully acknowledge every good thing that is ours in Christ

verses.original: χαρὰν γὰρ πολλὴν ἔσχον καὶ παράκλησιν ἐπὶ τῇ ἀγάπῃ σου ὅτι τὰ σπλάγχνα τῶν ἁγίων ἀναπέπαυται διὰ σοῦ ἀδελφέ
verses.transliteration: charan gar pollēn eschon kai paraklēsin epi tē agapē sou hoti ta splanchna tōn hagiōn anapepautai dia sou adelphe
verses.literal: I take great joy and encouragement in your love because you brother have refreshed the hearts of the saints

verses.original: Διό πολλὴν ἐν Χριστῷ παρρησίαν ἔχων ἐπιτάσσειν σοι τὸ ἀνῆκον
verses.transliteration: Dio pollēn en Christō parrēsian echōn epitassein soi to anēkon
verses.literal: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper

verses.original: διὰ τὴν ἀγάπην μᾶλλον παρακαλῶ τοιοῦτος ὢν ὡς Παῦλος πρεσβύτης νυνὶ δὲ καὶ δέσμιος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: dia tēn agapēn mallon parakalō toioutos ōn hōs Paulos presbytēs nyni de kai desmios Christou Iēsou
verses.literal: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love For I Paul am now aged and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ σε περὶ τοῦ ἐμοῦ τέκνου ὃν ἐγέννησα ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς Ὀνήσιμον
verses.transliteration: Parakalō se peri tou emou teknou hon egennēsa en tois desmois Onēsimon
verses.literal: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus whose father I became while I was in chains

verses.original: τόν ποτέ σοι ἄχρηστον νυνὶ δὲ καὶ σοὶ καὶ ἐμοὶ εὔχρηστον
verses.transliteration: ton pote soi achrēston nyni de kai soi kai emoi euchrēston
verses.literal: Formerly he was useless to you but now he has become useful both to you and to me

verses.original: ὃν ἀνέπεμψά σοι αὐτόν τοῦτ’ ἔστιν τὰ ἐμὰ σπλάγχνα
verses.transliteration: hon anepempsa soi auton tout’ estin ta ema splanchna
verses.literal: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart

verses.original: ὃν ἐγὼ ἐβουλόμην πρὸς ἐμαυτὸν κατέχειν ἵνα ὑπὲρ σοῦ μοι διακονῇ ἐν τοῖς δεσμοῖς τοῦ εὐαγγελίου
verses.transliteration: hon egō eboulomēn pros emauton katechein hina hyper sou moi diakonē en tois desmois tou euangeliou
verses.literal: I would have liked to keep him with me so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel

verses.original: Χωρὶς δὲ τῆς σῆς γνώμης οὐδὲν ἠθέλησα ποιῆσαι ἵνα μὴ ὡς κατὰ ἀνάγκην τὸ ἀγαθόν σου ᾖ ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἑκούσιον
verses.transliteration: Chōris de tēs sēs gnōmēs ouden ēthelēsa poiēsai hina mē hōs kata anankēn to agathon sou ē alla kata hekousion
verses.literal: But I did not want to do anything without your consent so that your goodness will not be . . . out of compulsion but by your own free will

verses.original: τάχα γὰρ διὰ τοῦτο ἐχωρίσθη πρὸς ὥραν ἵνα αἰώνιον αὐτὸν ἀπέχῃς
verses.transliteration: tacha gar dia touto echōristhē pros hōran hina aiōnion auton apechēs
verses.literal: For perhaps this is why . . . he was separated from you for a while so that you might have him back . . . for good

verses.original: οὐκέτι ὡς δοῦλον ἀλλὰ ὑπὲρ δοῦλον ἀδελφὸν ἀγαπητόν μάλιστα ἐμοί πόσῳ δὲ μᾶλλον σοὶ καὶ ἐν σαρκὶ καὶ ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: ouketi hōs doulon alla hyper doulon adelphon agapēton malista emoi posō de mallon soi kai en sarki kai en Kyriō
verses.literal: no longer as a slave but better than a slave as a beloved brother He is especially beloved to me but even more so . . . to you both in person and in the Lord

verses.original: Εἰ οὖν με ἔχεις κοινωνόν προσλαβοῦ αὐτὸν ὡς ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: Ei oun me echeis koinōnon proslabou auton hōs eme
verses.literal: So if you consider me a partner receive him as you would receive me

verses.original: εἰ δέ τι ἠδίκησέν σε ἢ ὀφείλει τοῦτο ἐμοὶ ἐλλόγα
verses.transliteration: ei de ti ēdikēsen se ē opheilei touto emoi elloga
verses.literal: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything charge it to my account

verses.original: ἐγὼ Παῦλος ἔγραψα τῇ ἐμῇ χειρί ἐγὼ ἀποτίσω ἵνα μὴ λέγω σοι ὅτι καὶ σεαυτόν μοι προσοφείλεις
verses.transliteration: egō Paulos egrapsa tē emē cheiri egō apotisō hina mē legō soi hoti kai seauton moi prosopheileis
verses.literal: I Paul write this with my own hand I will repay it not to mention that you owe me your very self

verses.original: Ναί ἀδελφέ ἐγώ σου ὀναίμην ἐν Κυρίῳ ἀνάπαυσόν μου τὰ σπλάγχνα ἐν Χριστῷ
verses.transliteration: Nai adelphe egō sou onaimēn en Kyriō anapauson mou ta splanchna en Christō
verses.literal: Yes brother let me have some benefit from you in the Lord Refresh my heart in Christ

verses.original: Πεποιθὼς τῇ ὑπακοῇ σου ἔγραψά σοι εἰδὼς ὅτι καὶ ὑπὲρ ἃ λέγω ποιήσεις
verses.transliteration: Pepoithōs tē hypakoē sou egrapsa soi eidōs hoti kai hyper ha legō poiēseis
verses.literal: Confident of your obedience I write to you knowing that you will do even more than I ask

verses.original: Ἅμα δὲ καὶ ἑτοίμαζέ μοι ξενίαν ἐλπίζω γὰρ ὅτι διὰ τῶν προσευχῶν ὑμῶν χαρισθήσομαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Hama de kai hetoimaze moi xenian elpizō gar hoti dia tōn proseuchōn hymōn charisthēsomai hymin
verses.literal: In the meantime . . . prepare a guest room for me because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you

verses.original: Ἀσπάζεταί σε Ἐπαφρᾶς ὁ συναιχμάλωτός μου ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Aspazetai se Epaphras ho synaichmalōtos mou en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Epaphras my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus sends you greetings . . .

verses.original: Μᾶρκος Ἀρίσταρχος Δημᾶς Λουκᾶς οἱ συνεργοί μου
verses.transliteration: Markos Aristarchos Dēmas Loukas hoi synergoi mou
verses.literal: as do Mark Aristarchus Demas and Luke my fellow workers

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μετὰ τοῦ πνεύματος ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou meta tou pneumatos hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit
